provenance: Independently authored additive ledger rows for existing floorplan_cross geometry constants. Values remain 5 mm mounting-hole inset and 0.4 mm edge pad clearance; no placement calculation changes.

assumption_rows.name: mounting_hole_inset
assumption_rows.text: ASSUME mounting_hole_inset            = 5             mm         [policy] floorplan.mh_inset — mounting-hole center inset used by the cross-net geometry estimator

assumption_rows.name: edge_pad_clearance
assumption_rows.text: ASSUME edge_pad_clearance             = 0.4           mm         [policy] floorplan.edge_pad_clear — connector pad clearance from the outline used by the cross-net geometry estimator
